name: Mood Security
tagline: Weekly read-only security sweep across your GitHub repositories, repairs ranked.
description: Once a week this one walks through your GitHub repositories hunting for trouble it can see without touching anything: credentials left in code or in past commits, dependency advisories, alerts nobody closed, and branch rules too loose to catch mistakes. You get back a short prioritised repair list, not scanner noise.
author: bdvd_25
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
